propositions: Bridge execution must be runner-neutral and callable identically across local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments through a single packaged entrypoint without repository-local scripts
Legacy reconcile mode callers and checked-out workflows must preserve their behavior, defaults, exit codes, and mutation boundaries unchanged
Destructive-repair pause ownership must be provider-neutral and use git-based durable gate coordination (refs/reconciler/gate) without GitHub CLI dependency
Repair pause acquisition and release must use per-invocation repair identity tokens and CAS-based OID locking with foreign-pause abort semantics and operator-only recovery
The provider-neutral durable gate lifecycle must read existing pause snapshot, call set_pause, and clear only the observed OID without automatic retry reclaim
No new lower-trust-actor reachability or unauthenticated boundary-crossing surfaces are introduced; existing credential and authentication handling remains unchanged
